headline: FinCEN discloses cybersecurity incident, takes systems offline
summary: FinCEN, the Treasury Department's financial crimes bureau, disclosed a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to some of its systems, taking systems offline and extending filing deadlines while it investigates. The bureau has not detailed the incident's scope or source.

claims.statement: FinCEN, part of the Treasury Department, disclosed it is investigating a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to some of its systems.

sources.quote: it's looking into an "incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems."
US Treasury financial crimes unit becomes latest fed breach victim

claims.statement: FinCEN has not disclosed the scope or source of the incident.
